name: modern-spring-boot-microservices-best-practices
description: Comprehensive engineering standards, architectural patterns, and production guardrails for modern Microservices using modern Spring Boot 3.x+: database-per-service isolation, declarative HTTP interfaces with RestClient, Resilience4j fault tolerance, transactional Outbox & Saga distributed data patterns, Spring Cloud Gateway with OAuth2/JWT token relay, distributed tracing with Micrometer & OpenTelemetry, and consumer-driven contract testing.
displayName: Modern Spring Boot Microservices Best Practices
suggestedPrompts: Design microservice boundaries following Domain-Driven Design and database-per-service
Implement Resilience4j circuit breakers, retries, and declarative HTTP interfaces
Configure distributed tracing with Micrometer, OpenTelemetry, and structured logging
